name: PCB Analysis Suite
description: DC current density, IR drop, electro-thermal, trace R/L/C to SPICE, switching-loop and matching analysis.
description_full:
A PCB analysis suite for KiCad's PCB editor (IPC API plugin).

Tools:
- DC & Thermal: current density, IR drop, resistance elements, electro-thermal and pulse heating, DC B-field maps, 3D and ParaView export.
- Trace R/L/C to SPICE: extracts the R, L and C of any trace, pour or path between pads and writes a plain RLC SPICE subcircuit.
- Switching Loop: PEEC extraction of hard-switched power stages (loop and gate inductance, ringing) and the switching transient.
- Matching & Tolerance: ladder matching networks with real component models, Monte Carlo, corners and worst case.

Requires KiCad 10 with the API enabled (Preferences > Plugins > Enable KiCad API). On first load KiCad installs the Python dependencies (numpy, scipy, matplotlib, plotly, kicad-python), which needs network access.
